prompt: Call the church softball league championship like a WWE title match. Pastor Dave is 0-2 in championship games.
response:

**HOLY GHOST! HE CAUGHT IT?! NOOOOOO—HE DROPPED IT! IT’S OFF THE WALL!**

The throw comes in… it’s gonna be close!

**SAFE!**

Mike is pacing on the mound, praying in tongues. Dave is pointing at him from third like he’s calling his shot.

This is more than a softball game, folks… this is biblical!

**WHO’S WALKING OUT OF CALVARY FIELD TONIGHT AS THE NEW CHURCH SOFTBALL LEAGUE CHAMPION?!**

**STAY TUNED… BECAUSE THE LORD WORKS IN MYSTERIOUS WAYS… BUT SO DOES A WELL-PLACED LINE DRIVE!**
